A.text: A centromere holds two chromatids together until the end of prophase and attaches to the microtubules of the spindle.

B.text: A chromatid is one of two identical parts of a chromosome and is made of proteins and two molecules of DNA.

C.text: A chromosome is a structure with two identical parts, made of DNA and proteins, found in the nucleus of a prokaryotic cell.

D.text: A telomere is a sequence of DNA nucleotides, such as GGGTAA, repeated many times and found at the ends of each chromatid.
